Target: Sign in, use the app, change password, sign out
Expected behaviour: The new password works, the old one and the old token are refused
Automated by: UI-01; UI-08; UI-09; AUD-A06; AUD-A08; mock-api.test
Manual check / steps: Sign in as demo; change nothing; register an ordinary user (admin); sign in as that user; change their password; confirm the message, the automatic sign-out and that the old password no longer works; sign out and replay the old token

Expected behaviour: The token works once, expires after 10 minutes, and three requests a day are allowed
Manual check / steps: Ask for a reset token for a user; read it from the local outbox (admin Development > Outbox); reset the password; sign in; try the token again

Expected behaviour: 429 for that ID only; a deactivated user's session ends at once; reset revokes every session
Manual check / steps: Enter ten wrong passwords for one ID; deactivate a signed-in user; reset the data

Expected behaviour: The user sees and edits only workers in all four scopes; an empty assignment shows nothing; nested reports respect the scope
Manual check / steps: Register a user; assign business unit, contractor, department, location and a WRITE activity; sign in as that user

Target: Onboard a contractor and a worker
Expected behaviour: The worker is created; the edit is applied only after approval and keeps any later change; unknown references are refused
Manual check / steps: Add a contractor; add a worker for that contractor with department, business unit and entity; edit the worker (pending); approve the change as an administrator

Expected behaviour: A bad row blocks the whole batch; a clean one inserts; a repeat is refused unless UPSERT is chosen; numeric cells become text
Manual check / steps: Open Development > Import; validate (dry run) a workbook with a bad row; fix it; commit; repeat the commit

Expected behaviour: Duplicate keys and renames onto an existing key are refused; a record still used by workers, allocations or manpower cannot be deleted or re-keyed
Manual check / steps: Add, rename and delete a business unit, location, division, cost centre, city, shift group and holiday

Expected behaviour: Only listed marks are accepted; duplicates are refused with the reason; an approved regularisation is read-only until withdrawn
Manual check / steps: Enter a manual muster mark (every mark in the list); upload a muster workbook; regularise a punch; approve it; try to edit it; withdraw the approval and edit

Expected behaviour: Punches are stored, first and last punch become IN/OUT, duplicates are counted, and no payable-day rule is applied (the screen says so)
Manual check / steps: Upload punches; run Process attendance; read the job

Expected behaviour: References are checked; overlapping requests are refused; approval stays "awaiting BFCL rules"
Manual check / steps: Add approved manpower; add an on-duty request; approve and reject requests

Expected behaviour: Workbooks have the right columns and totals; an empty or failing export shows an error, never "printed successfully"
Manual check / steps: Export monthly attendance with times (single sheet and per contractor), monthly sheet (XLS) and daily register; try an empty range; try From after To

Expected behaviour: Balance moves by the days taken and returns on delete; overlap and days longer than the dates are refused; payroll posting answers 422
Manual check / steps: Add a leave; query the ledger; add a manual ledger row; delete the leave; try overlapping and over-long leave

Expected behaviour: Rates are effective-dated rows; a month with inputs cannot be deleted; PF/ESI/LWF accept Y or N only
Manual check / steps: Add a process month; add a fixed wage (billing type M, PF Y/N); add a second effective-dated rate; delete a month that has inputs

Expected behaviour: The code lists work in the screens; duplicates and bad rows are refused whole; amounts of 0 are allowed
Manual check / steps: Add an earning, a deduction and an arrear; try duplicates; upload a workbook with one bad row; add a service-charge rule

Expected behaviour: Edits answer 423 for that contractor only
Manual check / steps: Lock a month for a contractor; try to edit its inputs and rates; unlock

Expected behaviour: 422/501 with the missing BFCL rules; no figure is ever shown as a result
Manual check / steps: Try Process wages and every statement and report

Expected behaviour: Version conflicts answer 409; unverified status cannot be set to verified; reports show recorded data only
Manual check / steps: Create a state profile; make it active; edit its rules with a stale version; open each compliance report

Expected behaviour: Seed fixtures return, every session is revoked, the second run starts clean
